integrity: The next-generation matrices are reconstructed directly from the current infected equations.
The threshold reversal is witnessed by exact rational arithmetic and a Jacobian determinant of -1/5, so no floating-point sign decision is used.
The current and first public preprint versions and the earlier deterministic predecessor were compared at the equation level.
scientific_limitations: The correction is version-specific to the current v3 model equations and does not claim that every numerical optimal-control trajectory is qualitatively wrong.
The exact counterexample concerns local invasion at a disease-free equilibrium; endemic equilibria and time-varying-control thresholds are outside scope.
The earlier v1 preprint used a different infection convention and is not itself contradicted by the v3-specific calculation.
title: The printed noncompliance reproduction ratio can reverse disease-free stability
